title: Certify v0.3.0: the tournament packing numbers nu_3(9) = 9 and nu_3(10) = 12, certified (first certified determination, extending Yuster's verified range from n <= 8 to n <= 10)
description: First certified determination of the minimum TT3-packing numbers nu_3(9) = 9 and nu_3(10) = 12, where nu_3(n) is the minimum over all n-vertex tournaments of the maximum number of arc-disjoint transitive triples, confirming R. Yuster's 2004 conjectured formula ceil(n(n-1)/6 - n/3) at n = 9, 10. CLAIMED AS NEW: the certified integral lower bounds over all tournament isomorphism classes (191,536 at n = 9; 9,733,056 at n = 10, enumeration count-validated against OEIS A000568 and exact Burnside numbers), with SAT (LRAT) optimality certificates on the minimizing tournaments C3[C3,C3,C3] and C3[TT4,C3,C3], replayable with stock Python; and the resulting first certified determination of both values. NOT CLAIMED, AND CREDITED: the quantity, the formula, the n <= 8 verification, and the matching upper-bound constructions are Yuster's (2004); the fractional relaxation and blow-up analysis are Kabiya-Yuster's (2008). Declared trust assumption: gentourng (nauty) enumerates completely (cross-validated exhaustively for n <= 7, count-validated at n = 9, 10). The note passed a three-lens adversarial review (claims-vs-artifacts, priority against primary sources read verbatim, replay audit with negative controls) before release; the review log ships as tt3-paper/FIXLOG.md and the dated novelty sweep as SWEEP-RECORD-TT3-2026-08-05.md. Computations carried out with Claude (Fable 5); independently re-verified by a separate agent instance with independently written code.
